meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 把消息里附带的 Word、PPT、表格、PDF 等文件在本地转成 Markdown 文本并读出内容。转换在容器内完成，不会把文件上传到外部解析服务。扫描版 PDF 等不支持的情况会明确报错。
howto.when: 当消息里带有本地附件路径，需要读取 Word、演示文稿、电子表格、PDF 等文档内容时触发；尤其适用于不想把文件上传到外部解析器的场合。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 文档转成 Markdown 并总结。
say.note: 会调用 anydoc 在容器内本地转换。

say.text: 这个演示文稿转成 Markdown，把标题和正文分开。
say.note: 会生成 Markdown 后读取内容。

say.text: 这份 CSV 转成 Markdown，展示各列名称。
say.note: CSV 默认从标准输入读取，并带格式参数。

howto.what_en: Converts attached Office documents, PDFs, CSV, EPUB, and similar files to Markdown locally, then reads the output. Files are not uploaded to an external parser. Unsupported formats or scan-only PDFs are reported clearly.
howto.when_en: When the user supplies a local attachment path for a document that must be read, e.g., Word/PPT/spreadsheet/PDF, especially without uploading it to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word document to Markdown and summarize it.
say_en.note: It uses anydoc locally in the container.

say_en.text: Turn this presentation into Markdown, separating titles from body text.
say_en.note: It converts via anydoc and reads the output.

say_en.text: Convert this CSV to Markdown and show column names.
say_en.note: CSV reads from stdin with an explicit format flag.
